title: Evaluating safety and quality of robotic-assisted gastric cancer surgery: meta-analysis and meta-regression.

adjudication.design_quote: In all, 90 studies (65 296 patients) were included; only three studies were randomized clinical trials and 72 were from East Asia.
adjudication.k_quote: In all, 90 studies (65 296 patients) were included; only three studies were randomized clinical trials
adjudication.reason: Predominantly observational review (87 of 90 non-randomised) pooling all designs; no RCT-only pooled synthesis reported.
